sanskrit: oṃ namaḥ śivāya nikhilatattvātmane | atha parāprāveśikā śrīmanmahāmāheśvarācāryavaryakṣemarājaviracitā | viśvātmikāṃ taduttirṇāṃ hṛdayaṃ parameśituḥ | parādiśaktirūpeṇa sphurantīṃ saṃvidaṃ numaḥ

iha khalu parameśvaraḥ prakāśātmā, prakāśaśca vimarśasvabhāvaḥ, vimarśo nāma viśvākāreṇa viśvaprakāśena viśvasaṃharaṇena ca akṛtrimāham iti visphuraṇam | yadi nirvimarśaḥ syāt anīśvaro jaḍaśca prasajyeta
eṣa eva ca vimarśaḥ - cit, caitanyaṃ, svarasoditāparāvāk, svātantryaṃ, paramātmano mukhyamaiśvaryaṃ, kartṛtvaṃ, sphurattā, sāro, hṛdayaṃ, spandaḥ ityādiśabdairāgameṣūddhoṣyate

ata eva akṛtrimāhamiti satattvaḥ svayaṃprakāśarūpaḥ parameśvaraḥ pārameśvaryā śaktyā śivādi-dharaṇyantajagadātmanā sphurati prakāśate ca | etadeva asya jagataḥ kartṛtvamajaḍatvaṃ ca | jagataḥ kāryatvamapi etadadhīnaprakāśatvameva | prakāśarūpāt karturmaheśvarādabhinnameva | na kadācit tirodhīyate
pūrvasiddhasya maheśvarasya svayaṃprakāśatvaṃ sarvasya svasaṃvedanasiddham | pramāṇānyapi vastūnāṃ jīvitaṃ yāni tanvate | teṣāmapi paro jīvaḥ sa eva parameśvaraḥ

śabdarāśimayapūrṇāhantāparāmarśasāratvāt paramaśiva eva ṣaṭtriṃśattattvātmakaḥ prapañcaḥ | 1 śiva 2 śakti 3 sadāśiva 4 īśvara 5 śuddhavidyā 6 māyā 7 kalā 8 vidyā 9 rāga 10 kāla 11 niyati 12 puruṣa 13 prakṛti 14 buddhi 15 ahaṃkāra 16 manaḥ 17-21 jñānendriyāṇi 22-26 karmendriyāṇi 27-31 tanmātrāṇi 32-36 bhūtāni

athaiṣāṃ lakṣaṇāni | tatra śivatattvaṃ nāma icchājñānakriyātmakakevalapūrṇānandasvabhāvarūpaḥ paramaśiva eva | sadāśivatattvam | sthitamīśvaratattvam | ahantedantayoraikyapratipattiḥ śuddhavidyā | svasvarūpeṣu bhāveṣu bhedaprathā māyā | yadā tu parameśvaraḥ pārameśvaryā māyāśaktyā svarūpaṃ gṛhayitvā saṃkucitagrāhakatāmaśnute tadā puruṣasaṃjñaḥ | ciddhano muktaḥ paramaśiva eva | śaktayo'saṃkucitā api saṃkocagrahaṇena kalāvidyārāgakālaniyatirūpatayā bhavanti

kalā kiṃcitkartṛtāhetuḥ | vidyā kiṃcijjñatvakāraṇam | rāgo viṣayeṣvabhiṣvaṅgaḥ | kālo bhūtādiḥ | niyatiḥ mamedaṃ kartavyaṃ nedaṃ kartavyam iti niyamanahetuḥ | etat pañcakam kañcukam | prakṛtiḥ sattvarajastamasāṃ sāmyāvasthā | buddhiḥ | ahaṃkāro | manaḥ | pañca jñānendriyāṇi | pañca karmendriyāṇi | pañca tanmātrāṇi | ākāśamavakāśapradam | vāyuḥ saṃjīvanaḥ | agnirdāhakaḥ pācakaśca | salilamāpyāyakaṃ dravarūpaṃ ca | bhūmirdhārikā
verses: 5 sheaths; kañcuka; prakrti; antahkarana; indriyas; tanmatras; bhutas

sanskrit: yathā nyagrodhabījasthaḥ śaktirūpo mahādrumaḥ | tathā hṛdayabījasthaṃ viśvametaccarācaram | hṛdayabīje'ntarbhūtametajjagat | tadantargatamekatriṃśattattvam | viśvamayo viśvottīrṇaḥ paramaśiva eva | īdṛśaṃ hṛdayabījaṃ tattvato yo veda samāviśati ca sa paramārthato dīkṣitaḥ | jīvanmukta eva bhavati, dehapāte paramaśivabhaṭṭāraka eva bhavati | iti parāprāveśikā samāptā
verses: bija verse (amnaya); pot/ghee; phonemic involution; hridayabija = Paramasiva; phala; colophon
